payload.title: TREE_DISAGREES_GRADES omits empty_glob, the grade for a glob that matches no file, so a seat citing such a glob ranks as a cited observation above an argument-only seat and the brief's own list of grades that mean the tree does not carry the ref leaves it out.
evidence: aria-kernel/aria_kernel/evidence_trust.py:215-223 (TREE_DISAGREES_GRADES is described as the grades by which the tree positively does not carry a citation, and lists missing, invalid, self_output and worktree_candidate only)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/evidence_trust.py:582-591 (a glob with fewer than MIN_GLOB_MATCHES matching files, including none, is graded empty_glob)

aria-kernel/aria_kernel/judge_fanout.py:871-888 (_standing_refs keeps every ref whose grade is outside the set, so an empty_glob seat ranks 2 (cited observation) above a seat citing nothing at rank 3)

aria-kernel/aria_kernel/judge_fanout.py:966-972 (the brief names missing, invalid, self_output and worktree_candidate as the grades that mean the tree does not carry the citation; empty_glob is not mentioned)

aria-kernel/aria_kernel/evidence_validator.py:585-593 (the submit gate refuses a glob seat ref as agent_evidence_path_missing, so today a glob reaches a seat row only when the row was written without that gate)
payload.rule_violated: One owner names the grades that mean the tree does not carry a ref (the J3 constant's own stated purpose); the constant must be exhaustive over what classify_evidence_ref can emit.
payload.notes: A seat row whose evidence_refs holds a glob that matches no file (for example src/nothing-*.ts) is graded empty_glob at mint. Because empty_glob is not in TREE_DISAGREES_GRADES, _standing_refs keeps the ref, the seat ranks as a cited observation above a seat that cites nothing, and the brief never tells the arbiter that an empty glob is a citation the tree does not carry. The submit gate refuses glob refs, so this needs a seat row written without that gate; the gap is in the new constant and its brief text, not in the grader. Close condition: empty_glob is added to TREE_DISAGREES_GRADES and to the brief's list at judge_fanout.py:966-972, and a test in test_j3_every_split_weighed.py grades a seat citing a glob that matches no file and asserts it ranks with argument-only seats, below a seat whose ref the tree carries. Plan row: J3 (the F0.7 exit). Verified at head 3451f5c3fc of open pull request #2135; the cited code is not on main until that pull request merges.
